blocks.text:
## Jungle, archaeology and the Caribbean Sea

The first part of your trip takes you into the Mountain Pine Ridge area. Stay at Blancaneaux Lodge amid the pine forest, visit waterfalls and natural pools, then head to the ruins of Caracol.

After visiting Barton Creek Cave, continue to the Caribbean coast. On Ambergris Caye, explore beaches, lagoons and mangroves and discover the marine life of Hol Chan. The final day is spent in Belize City, the former capital and the country’s largest city.
